title: Flood recovery Back Home grant – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the Back Home grant, detailing eligibility, funding, and the assessment process for flood recovery assistance.
who_can_apply: The guidelines specify who is eligible for the Back Home grant following a flood event.
Eligibility criteria are detailed within the document.

faqs.q: What is the Back Home grant?
faqs.a: The Back Home grant provides assistance to help people recover after a flood event.

faqs.a: Eligibility criteria are detailed in the guidelines, covering who can apply for assistance.

faqs.a: The assessment and approval process outlines the steps required to apply for and receive the grant.
